title: One BL file → client · server · contract
lede: The checklist below is `showcase.bl`. The compiler decided which half each function runs in.
hints: Try it: call `flagged-title?` from `board-view` and rebuild — the build refuses and names `board-view → flagged-title? → blocked-words`.

Sort and refine are **function values**: `arrange` calls a key function and a comparator looked up from `(orderings)`; the chips are predicates built with `complement`, `partial`, `comp` and a function-returning function, folded by `all-of` into one predicate — all in your browser. The build proves every call chain finite: calls values · a value · recursion: capture-order.
